verdict.rationale: Fathom documents self-serve API keys on all plans, a list-meetings endpoint, and dedicated transcript and summary endpoints that return data directly, so scripts can pull transcripts and summaries. Action items are only evidenced as an optional webhook payload (push), not as a pull endpoint, and pulling 'every meeting' is limited to your own and team-shared meetings unless an Admin is granted view access. Missing for 10: a documented pull endpoint for action items, account-wide access without admin permission configuration, no published OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my scripts can pull transcripts, summaries, and action items from every meeting through a documented API with self-serve keys

citations.quote: API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans. Generate a key in User Settings → API Access.
List the 10 most recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team.
If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.
Either the destination URL for where we'll POST the call summary, or the summary for the recording.
At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.
grant one or more Admins view access to all shared calls; that Admin’s key can then read everything shared across teams.
